description: False-colour infrared satellite image showing aquaculture ponds and surrounding land cover in Goro, Italy, captured on 2018-07-02. The image uses a 1/2/3 band combination (Near-Infrared, Red, Green). The central area features a cluster of bright blue water bodies identified as aquaculture ponds, with one large pond appearing darker blue. These ponds are set within an agricultural landscape dominated by rectangular fields shown in shades of red (indicating healthy vegetation) and light grey/white (representing bare soil or harvested areas). To the western side, a small settlement or urbanized area is visible as dense clusters of grey/white features. A winding river or canal, depicted in dark blue/cyan, flows across the top-right and bottom-right parts of the image. The image effectively visualises the distribution of cultivated land and managed water bodies. The data credit is CCME 2018, provided under the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) by the European Union and European Space Agency (ESA).
